headings.title: Every documented assignment, in one view.
headings.lead: Each dot is one assignment in IP3's documented record: the same records shown on Capabilities. Keep scrolling and they sort themselves.

headings.title: Who commissioned the work
headings.lead: Rows group the assignments by the type of client recorded for each one. Highlighted dots share the client name that appears most often.

headings.title: Where each assignment sits in the chain
headings.lead: The six phases are the delivery chain on the home page. Each assignment is evidence for exactly one phase there.

headings.title: Which sectors the work serves
headings.lead: Rows follow the assignments listed on the eight sector pages. An assignment listed on two sector pages appears in both rows, highlighted.

headings.title: Sort it and search it yourself.
headings.lead: Choose a grouping, type part of a client's name, or select a dot to read the assignment.

headings.title: Built only from the published record
headings.lead: Client and client type come from each assignment's record. Phases come from the delivery chain on the home page, and sectors from the evidence lists on the sector pages. Nothing is estimated: the counts are recalculated from those sources every time the site is built.
